Name: Natural Clock
Author: FablePH
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][*]Install the latest version of ContentPatcher.
[/url][*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/ContentPatcher[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.﻿﻿
[/list]
This mod will replace the tacky Golden Clock with a new clock styled after the other farm buildings for a more natural and fitting aesthetic for your farm.

There are two download links available! The main download gives you the Content Patcher compatible version of this mod with all the necessary parts needed to run after following the installation instructions above. The second link will only give you the .xnb version of this mod, which is NOT COMPATIBLE with Content Patcher and must be installed manually by going into Stardew Valley/Content/Buildings and manually replacing the Gold Clock.xnb file you see there. Remember that traditional .xnb mods are [i]no longer recommended[/i], and that you might face issues in future game updates if you choose to install this mod via this method.

Hope you enjoy!
